description:
No spec subject change in the structural sense; this edits specled.tagged_tests.failed_run_preserves_attribution_artifact within subject specled.tagged_tests.

Follow-up from specled_-td7, recommended independently by two cold audit rounds (2026-07-27).

The requirement currently says the artifact copy shall be best-effort "under the SAME guard as the output capture, not a parallel one of its own ... One guard, one contract, one proof." The middle clause is a constraint on SOURCE STRUCTURE, not an observable outcome, and no test can enforce it. A surviving mutation demonstrates the gap: wrapping the preserve_artifact/2 call in its own silent `try ... rescue _ in File.Error -> :ok end` — the exact arrangement the clause forbids — leaves the suite green.

Why it cannot be tested, established across three verification rounds: distinguishing one shared guard from two parallel ones needs a state where the LOG write succeeds and the ARTIFACT write specifically fails. The capture filename carries a per-run nonce, so nothing can pre-block that path. Exotic states exist (a disk filling between the two adjacent writes; a capture directory deep enough that the log path fits under the OS path limit while the 14-bytes-longer artifact path does not) but none is a state a reasonable test constructs.

Proposed fix: trim the must to what is observable and already tested — a filesystem failure in either write leaves the verification result unchanged and emits the one-line stderr warning (verifier_test.exs, the merged unwritable-dir test and the generic sibling). Move the single-guard rationale to the code comment, where it already lives, and out of normative text.

Precedent on the same branch: an equivalent structural assertion was caught in this requirement own scenario `then` clause and replaced with a real outcome clause; the identical reflex was left standing in the `must`.

Deliberately deferred from specled_-td7 rather than done there: spec surgery on a branch that had already produced eleven prose defects was judged worse than tracking it.
title: Trim failed_run_preserves_attribution_artifact's must to its observable content
